$comment: Shape, canonicalization and signing, entry validation and client acceptance rules of the search-catalog/v1 catalog (external search service contract, section 8). The catalog here is a sample catalog of 7 services; acceptCases incoming catalogs are already materialized and signed where needed. Expectations come from the reference implementation of the catalog rules. productionKeys are the production verification public keys (keyId -> 32-byte raw Ed25519 public key, base64); the private keys live only in the maintainer's login keychain. Server, iOS, Android and Web constants copy them verbatim.

testKeys.$comment: Test-only key, public in the fixture; the client trusts it only in tests, production trusts only the production public keys.

canonicalCases.$comment: Keys sort by UTF-16 code unit: the emoji (D83D...) sorts before U+FF61; sorting by Unicode scalar would reverse them
Only escape " \ and U+0000-U+001F (\b \f \n \r \t use the short form, the rest use lowercase \u00xx); / < > & U+007F U+2028 and non-ASCII stay as is
